fields.text: GRIMPACK pack-rip: the foil tear sounds (long climactic rip + short crinkle ticks for the stick-slip catches) and a torn-foil edge texture for the interactive SVG pack.

Tearing open a thick metallic foil packet, extremely close microphone: one long heavy rip, the foil resists in stages then gives way, crackling metallic crinkle and shredding, deep and unsettling, ASMR detail. Sound effect only, no music, no voices.
A single short sharp crinkle of stiff metallic foil being flexed and squeezed once, brittle crackly texture, extremely close microphone. One brief sound effect only, no music, no voices.

One long horizontal strip of torn silver foil packaging, a jagged ripped metallic edge with crinkles, curls and flakes, running straight across the middle of the frame, photographed from directly above on a pure black background, studio product shot, high detail
